newsitem.title: USA: Actress Liz Taylor's brain surgery postponed.
newsitem.headline: Actress Liz Taylor's brain surgery postponed.

text.p: Actress Elizabeth Taylor's surgery to remove a benign brain tumour has been postponed because of a scheduling conflict involving a surgeon, her personal manager said on Wednesday.
The operation, which was set for Feb. 17, will take place later next week, Geoff Blain said.
The tumour was detected this month during a brain scan as part of a routine physical examination, but doctors expect Taylor to recover without complications.
Taylor, who just recovered from a bout of influenza, will attend a gala 65th birthday party in Hollywood this Sunday to benefit her AIDS Foundation. Her birthday is Feb. 27.
